topics.topic: Strings; Fixed-Size Sliding Window; Character Counting
topics.rationale: The attachment describes a fixed-window vowel-count maximum, with case-insensitive input. The equivalent lowercase LeetCode pattern is Medium.
Sorting the values and scanning gaps within two bounds suffices; no advanced data structure is required.
